head: 90ef0c5d
headSubject: fix(generator): REG-220 -- exempt GeneratedActionCapabilityAdapter from thin-projection guard
summary: Fixed REG-219 (UntrustedExtensionBytecodeInspector's java.io ban wrongly caught ByteArrayInputStream/ByteArrayOutputStream, blocking FiscalImportCapability.java) and, discovered while verifying it end-to-end, REG-220 (GeneratedProjectionGuard's thin-projection regex false-positived on the platform's own GeneratedActionCapabilityAdapter bridge class) -- both fixed with narrow exemptions mirroring each other, both proven with new regression tests, and both proven live: a from-scratch regeneration/build of the WmsOffice app now succeeds end to end for the first time this session (commits 75f7d401, 90ef0c5d, pushed to main). Also fixed a genuine app-definition gap found along the way: WmsOffice's AppGen source was missing definition/untrusted-extension-manifest.json entirely (only an ephemeral Build/ snapshot had one), propagated back to the source-of-truth layer with a correct widget entry.
nextStep: Regenerate the ACTUAL LIVE wmsoffice-browser app (port 8084, PID from prior sessions) to pick up both REG-219 and REG-220 -- NOT the scratch build at Build\generated-finalapps\wmsoffice used for this session's fix verification. Use the rebuild-app skill against AppGen\apps\_official\WmsOffice, targeting BuildRoot=Build\generated-finalapps\wmsoffice-browser specifically (that app root has its own secrets/data/logs already bootstrapped, unlike the scratch 'wmsoffice' root, which is still missing its JWT keypair and should not be treated as the real app). After it boots, re-verify REG-218 (Importar Contagem JAVA_SOURCE_OPERATION_NOT_BOUND -- does it survive a truly fresh build?) and re-check CrossDocking C4/C5 (the Romaneio import wizard, which needed ParseRomaneioProcedure -- confirm the workbench now shows the 'Importar (Parse Romaneio)' action button). Stopping the live :8084 process and rebuilding is a deliberate operational step (it holds prior sessions' seeded repro data and diagnostic state for REG-217/218), which is why it was not done as a drive-by extension of the REG-219 fix this session.
plan: D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\NPDev_General__OutsideRepo\roadmap-2026-09-14\NPDEV_MEGA_ROADMAP.md (Session 9/10, WMS-9.yml); this session's own work is filed as ledger/items/REG-219.yml (DONE) and ledger/items/REG-220.yml (DONE), both newly closed
verified: Narrow unit tests only, both green: gradlew -p NPDevKernel/kernel test --tests com.npdev.kernel.security.UntrustedExtensionBytecodeInspectorTest (BUILD SUCCESSFUL, incl. 2 new regression tests); gradlew -p NPDevGenerator/generator test --tests com.npdev.generator.guard.GeneratedProjectionGuardTest (BUILD SUCCESSFUL, incl. 1 new regression test). Full live verification: pwsh -File scripts/appgen/Rebuild-And-Restage.ps1 -AppFolder D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\AppGen\apps\_official\WmsOffice -SkipLibs against the scratch Build\generated-finalapps\wmsoffice root -- generator log shows 'Generator succeeded.' and Gradle reports 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL', producing a runnable FinalExec-0.1.0.jar; boot itself failed only on an unrelated missing JWT keypair in that scratch root (expected, not a regression). No full quality gate (run-all-gates.ps1) was run this session -- narrow verification only, per project norms for a targeted fix.
